newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 644 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 644 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 644 contracts compared with 1,290 overnight Tuesday.
There were 55 wheat, 308 corn, 217 soybean, 46 soymeal, nine soyoil, seven oat and two soybean options traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to two cents higher, corn was 1/2 to one cent higher and soybeans were unchanged to 1-1/2 cents higher.
